metadata.title: In-Q-Tel public roster (Wikipedia + Intercept + Dealroom + TipRanks)
metadata.caveat: WaPo 2016: 100+ IQT investments were secret. This is not the classified remainder.

entities.name: In_Q_Tel
entities.notes: CIA-chartered nonprofit VC. Washington Post 2016: 325 listed investments, 100+ secret. This roster is the public remainder compiled from Wikipedia, Intercept (2016), Dealroom, TipRanks, Gaebler — not the classified set.
